title: [MPS] MaxPool2d/3d fails to raise error for invalid output size (Silent Failure / Undefined Behavior)

labels.name: module: error checking
labels.description: Bugs related to incorrect/lacking error checking

labels.name: triaged
labels.description: This issue has been looked at a team member, and triaged and prioritized into an appropriate module

labels.name: module: mps

body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

### Bug description

- The MaxPool2d and MaxPool3d operators on the MPS backend fail to check if the calculated output dimension is valid.
- When the input dimension is smaller than the kernel size (and padding is insufficient), the expected behavior is to raise a RuntimeError: Output size is too small, which correctly happens on CPU.
- However, on MPS, the operation proceeds silently, returning a tensor with invalid/garbage values (Undefined Behavior) instead of raising an exception.


### Test script
```python
import torch

class Model(torch.nn.Module):

    def __init__(self):
        super(Model, self).__init__()
        # self.max_pool = torch.nn.MaxPool3d(kernel_size=2)
        self.max_pool = torch.nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=2)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.max_pool(x)
        return x

# test torch.nn.MaxPool3d
# x = torch.randn(1,1,1,4,4)
# test torch.nn.MaxPool2d
x = torch.randn(1,1,4)
try:
    model = Model()
    inputs = [x]
    print(model(*inputs))
except Exception as e:
    print(e)

try:
    model_mps = Model().to("mps")
    inputs_mps = [x.to("mps")]
    print(model_mps(*inputs_mps))
except Exception as e:
    print(e)
```

The output follows:
```bash
# test torch.nn.MaxPool2d
# on cpu
Given input size: (1x1x4). Calculated output size: (1x0x2). Output size is too small
# on mps
tensor([[[0.6540, 1.6511]]], device='mps:0')

# test torch.nn.MaxPool3d
# on cpu
Given input size: (1x1x4x4). Calculated output size: (1x0x2x2). Output size is too small
# on mps 
tensor([[[[[1.3667, 0.5344],
           [0.9216, 3.0316]]]]], device='mps:0')
```

### What's more

When I test the torch.nn.AvgPool2d/AvgPool3d, it has the same behaviour between cpu and mps.

```bash
# test torch.nn.MaxPool2d
Given input size: (1x1x4). Calculated output size: (1x0x2). Output size is too small
Given input size: (1x1x4). Calculated output size: (1x0x2). Output size is too small

# test torch.nn.MaxPool3d
input image (T: 1 H: 4 W: 4) smaller than kernel size (kT: 2 kH: 2 kW: 2)
input image (T: 1 H: 4 W: 4) smaller than kernel size (kT: 2 kH: 2 kW: 2)
```
### Bug Fix

For cpu,I found belows in  function:pool2d_shape_check and pool3d_shape_check

https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/21c11daffad809034507a2218dca6be946892b34/aten/src/ATen/native/Pool.h#L160-L166

And,we may fix this issue on mps in the near place
https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/21c11daffad809034507a2218dca6be946892b34/aten/src/ATen/native/mps/operations/Pooling.mm#L382-L389


If necessary,I can send a PR to fix it.
